tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Dahlia Mossbutton's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Focus on the 2018 will and health care directive prepared by Cassian Willowdoodle that name Lina Mossbutton as primary fiduciary and health care decision-maker, since they predate the 2023-09-16 marriage to Owen Cloudpuddle.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Dahlia Mossbutton and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location, including the 2018 will and health care directive prepared by Cassian Willowdoodle.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided, with attention to the Lina Mossbutton fiduciary and health care decision-maker roles that predate the marriage.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect those estate document copies by 2023-11-10.
